title: IIT Patna Notification 2026 - Apply for Junior Research Fellow Posts
description: Indian Institute of Technology Patna (IIT Patna) has declared the official notification for the recruitment of various Junior Research Fellow positions. Candidates who have qualified in the M.E/ M.Tech in Civil Engineering or M.Sc can grab this chance and apply for the IIT Patna Notification 2026 . Here, we have included the age limit, selection process, salary structure, education details, application fee, and how to apply for these posts.
